The interactive chat uses a default context size of **2048 tokens**.

This is shown in the README.md at line 33, where the example command `marin --model ... --ctx 2048 plan` demonstrates the default context size for the interactive `marin` command. The documentation notes that `marin` and `marin-run` have different default context sizes, so you need to pass `--ctx` when comparing them.
